Subject: Flagship stability sprint — exec coordination and customer readout

Team —

Heads-up: Flagship Commerce (DFL-4792) has run into a multi-region throughput regression over the last 36 hours. Error rate has crept from 0.8% to 4.6% on production inference routes; tail latency 99p has moved from ~520ms to ~1.8s on peak traffic. They just escalated to their CTO and asked for an executive update and a clear remediation timeline.

Immediate asks:
- David: I need a 1-pager (telemetry + root-cause hypotheses) by 10:30 PT with top 3 mitigations and estimated RTO. Attach the snapshot you referenced in the board call.
- Marissa: Prepare the customer status note and a 15-min readout slot for Monday 10:00 PT. Keep it concise, show actions and expected ETA.
- Laura: Please loop in Legal/Finance if we expect to offer credits; keep me posted.
- Vanessa: Stand up the exec bridge (Zoom link + #ops on Slack) and invite Flagship; target 09:45 PT Monday for pre-brief.

We need a single coordinated message to their leadership and a concise internal War Room playbook. I'll draft the top-level comms once I have your inputs. High priority — this is on the Exec radar.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
VP, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Flagship stability sprint — exec coordination and customer readout

Sean —

Quick diagnostic summary (snapshot attached):
- Observable: Error rate climbed starting 2026-11-20 14:20 PT, correlated with a sustained increase in median request size and a new A/B variant routing that increased multi-token prompts. Throughput per instance dropped ~18%.
- Hypotheses: 1) KV cache eviction churn due to larger prompt footprints; 2) New model variant (v3.1-fp16) has a regression in attention kernel that exacerbates long sequences on A100s; 3) Autoscaler oscillation under bursty ingress.
- Immediate mitigations (fast, medium, long):
  * Fast (10-60m): Force-serve to v2.9 (compatible) for the high-traffic tenant routes and disable the A/B variant. Patch routing rules for Flagship only.
  * Medium (2-6h): Increase reserved batch window for affected pools + raise max concurrency on dedicated nodes.
  * Long (24-72h): Roll model kernel fallback or pin to quantized variant and schedule kernel QA.

I'll push the trace export to the shared drive and attach the Prometheus snapshot. ETA for step 1 (force-serve + routing change): ~25 min once I get the go-ahead.

-David
David Kim
Director, Runtime Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prometheus-trace-20261121.json

Subject: Flagship status note and short readout (mon 10:00 PT)

Emma —

Thanks for flagging priorities. Quick readout draft below for leadership (one slide):

1) Current impact (what we see):
- Error rate on inference route flagship-core rose to 4.6% during peak windows (11/20 14:20 PT -> ongoing). Majority are 5xx model-runtime errors; user-facing errors ~2.1% of traffic.
- Tail latency 99p increased to ~1.8s; median ~370ms. A small subset (~3%) of requests are long-prompt outliers causing KV churn.

2) What we are doing now (actions in progress):
- 12:05 PT: Forcing traffic for Flagship to model v2.9 (rollback of A/B).
- 12:20 PT: Autoscaler tuning applied to affected GPU pools; raised max concurrency by 20% (short-term).
- 12:35 PT: Opened dedicated War Room; David leading mitigation and will run kernel-fallback tests.

3) Expected ETA and next check-in:
- Expected steady improvement within 2-6 hours after routing change; full stabilization (kernel QA + pin) 24-72 hours.
- Scheduled readout with your team and execs: Monday Nov 23, 2026 10:00 PT (15 min). Pre-brief for RW execs: 09:45 PT.

4) Customer impact & Black Friday note:
- Preliminary check: no direct overlap with Flagship's batch Black Friday jobs as those run on separate reserved pools; we will reconfirm in the pre-brief.

I'll attach the slide and telemetry appendix to the Monday readout. If you want a different cadence, say so and we'll adjust.

Regards,
Sean
VP, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
